entities.summary: Ruslana Stepanivna Lyzhychko, known mononymously as Ruslana, is a Ukrainian singer, songwriter, producer, activist and former politician. She is a World Music Award and Eurovision Song Contest winning recording artist, holding the title of People's Artist of Ukraine. She is also a former MP serving as deputy in the Ukrainian parliament for the Our Ukraine Party. Ruslana was the UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador in Ukraine in 2004–2005. She is recognized as the most successful Ukrainian female solo artist internationally and was included in the top 10 most influential women of 2013 by the Forbes magazine.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a former MP and UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, Ruslana played a crucial role in Ukraine's post-Soviet politics and international relations. Her advocacy efforts have had a lasting impact on Ukrainian society and the country's relationships with the global community.
